```go
type Action int

const (
	RightAction Action = iota
	LeftAction
	AdvanceAction
)

func StartRobot(command chan Command, action chan Action) {
	for c := range command {
		switch c {
		case 'L':
			action <- LeftAction
		case 'R':
			action <- RightAction
		case 'A':
			action <- AdvanceAction
		}
	}
	close(action)
}

func Room(extent Rect, robot Step2Robot, action chan Action, report chan Step2Robot) {
	for a := range action {
		switch a {
		case RightAction:
			robot.Dir = (robot.Dir + 1) % 4
		case LeftAction:
			robot.Dir = (robot.Dir + 3) % 4
		case AdvanceAction:
			p := robot.Pos
			switch robot.Dir {
			case N:
				p.Northing++
			case E:
				p.Easting++
			case S:
				p.Northing--
			case W:
				p.Easting--
			}
			if p.Easting >= extent.Min.Easting && p.Easting <= extent.Max.Easting &&
				p.Northing >= extent.Min.Northing && p.Northing <= extent.Max.Northing {
				robot.Pos = p
			}
		}
	}
	report <- robot
}
```
